name: Sphinx, Hieracosphinx
body:
Mythic Hieracosphinx
CR 6/MR 2

A cold-eyed falcon’s head and great wings adorn the body of this otherwise leonine creature.

XP 2,400
CE Large magical beast (mythic)
Init +3; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +16

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 12, flat-footed 17 (+3 Dex, +8 natural, –1 size)
hp 80 (8d10+36)
Fort +8, Ref +9, Will +4
DR 5/epic

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., fly 60 ft. (poor)
Melee bite +11 (1d10+4), 2 claws +11 (1d6+4)
Special Attacks diving strikeM, mythic power (2/day, surge +1d6), ominous shadowM, pounce, shriekm

STATISTICS

Str 19, Dex 16, Con 15, Int 6, Wis 15, Cha 10
Base Atk +8; CMB +13; CMD 26 (30 vs. trip)
Feats Cleave, Flyby Attack, Power AttackMF, Skill Focus (Perception)
Skills Fly +4, Perception +16; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception Languages Sphinx

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Diving Strike (Ex)

A mythic hieracosphinx can descend suddenly upon its prey from above in a lethal diving charge. This is equivalent to an aerial charge, but for every 15 feet that it descends as part of this charge, it gains a +1 circumstance bonus to attack and damage rolls made as part of the charge (to a maximum bonus of +4). Additionally, if the mythic hieracosphinx descended at least 60 feet as part of this action, it increases the critical multiplier of each of its natural attacks by 1 for the purposes of all attacks made as part of that action.

Shriek (Su)

The shrill shriek of a mythic hieracosphinx deafens non-sphinxes within a 60-foot-radius spread for 2d4 rounds (DC 16 Fort negates). A mythic hieracosphinx can expend one use of mythic power whenever it uses its shriek. If it does, affected creatures suffer 5d6 points of sonic damage, in addition to being deafened (if they succeed on the Fortitude save to resist being deafened, they suffer only half damage). Once a creature successfully saves against this effect, it is immune to the deafening effect of the hieracosphinx’s shriek for 24 hours, but not the sonic damage. If the hieracosphinx has a rider, it can choose to omit its rider from this effect. Using this ability is a standard action. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Ominous Shadow (Su)

As a swift action, a mythic hieracosphinx can expend one use of mythic power in order to imbue its shadow with an ominous feeling of impending doom. For one minute, any creature whose space the mythic hieracosphinx passes over must succeed on a Will save (DC 16) or become shaken for 1 minute. Creatures that fail their saving throw by 5 or more are frightened for 1 minute, instead. Whether a creature successfully saves or not, once it has made a saving throw to resist this effect, it is immune to it for 24 hours.

ECOLOGY

Environment warm hills
Organization solitary, pair, or flock (1-2 mythic hieracosphinxes, plus 3-10 non-mythic hieracosphinxes)
Treasure standard

Mythic hieracosphinxes fierce and savage cousins of their lesser kin, the common hieracosphinx. While the latter are a cowardly, cruel-hearted lot, their mythic brethren are bold almost to the point of self-destruction, full of bombast and insults and ready to hurl themselves in bloodthirsty flocks against any foe no matter how dangerous. Always male, their heads resemble a cruel hawk’s, with piercing eyes and a razor-sharp hooked beak. Their wings are often speckled or banded, while their leonine lower body is often a dark golden brown rather than the paler tawny coats of their sphinx cousins.
